summary: Every standing machine draws its authored fuel and water out of its faction's stockpile every hour, a machine the stockpile cannot cover is starved and stops standing, construction runs on the clock and a finished building journals it -- so a stockpile can fall and RecoveryLink::ResourceReserve can finally break.

coordination.notes: Other lanes run beside this one this round. godot_bridge.rs is touched only in the two exhaustive journal matches (an arm per new StrategicEvent variant); the bridge's state dictionary is lane P13's and is not edited here. building.rs takes a documentation correction only (advance_construction's 'nothing calls this on a clock' becomes false). tick.rs takes three variants appended at the END of StrategicEvent and two calls in run_hour. No new PURPOSES entry, no new ExpeditionState field, so save_migration.rs is untouched. content/ is not edited: C14 already authors fuel_resource_key and water_resource_key and Rust's MachineDefinition was missing both -- they are added to the Rust side so content owns the rates and Rust carries them.
